_comment: Differences a reviewer has investigated and accepted, with the reason. verify.py reports them but does not fail on them.

pe.BKNG: Checked 2026-11-06: roic.ai v2 divides by adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS (implied FY2025 EPS $8.84 post-split); v3, used in the deck, divides by GAAP diluted EPS ($6.62 post-split), which matches Booking's FY2025 10-K ($165.57 before the 25-for-1 split).

edgar_concepts.operating_income: roic.ai's operating income excludes items such as goodwill impairments and legal charges (Booking 2016 and 2020, Alphabet 2018 EU fine, Cummins charges). The deck uses GAAP OperatingIncomeLoss as filed.
edgar_concepts.buybacks: roic.ai reports repurchases net of stock issued to employees; the deck uses gross PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock as filed.
edgar_concepts.capex: roic.ai's capital-expenditure line is mis-mapped for some issuers (Cummins: about $50-80m a year against $500-730m in the 10-K cash flow statement). DATA-SOURCES.md in the briefing project records the same defect.
edgar_concepts.dividends: Small number of years where roic.ai's dividends line includes other distributions; the deck uses the 10-K's PaymentsOfDividends.
